name: Tea House / Bubble Tea Shop
description: Specialized beverage-forward concept centered on authentic Taiwanese bubble tea, freshly brewed artisan loose-leaf teas, and Asian refreshments. Distinguished by an interactive drink-building experience with granular sweetness, ice, milk base, and chewable boba topping customization, complemented by Asian street food snacks and cafe-style light bites.

sections.name: Classic Milk Tea
sections.description: The foundational cornerstone of any authentic Taiwanese bubble tea shop, featuring slow-brewed black, green, and roasted oolong teas blended with rich dairy or plant-based milks and caramelized syrups. This required core section drives primary ordering volume and represents the iconic boba experience, demanding full customer control over cup size, sweetness calibration, ice levels, milk choices, and freshly cooked chewable toppings.

subSections.name: Original Milk Tea
subSections.description: Timeless Taiwanese milk tea foundations brewed with robust Assam black tea, fragrant jasmine green tea, roasted Tieguanyin oolong, and floral Earl Grey tea leaves.

subSections.name: Brown Sugar Series
subSections.description: Signature tiger-striped beverages featuring caramelized brown sugar syrup swirled along the cup walls, paired with warm brown sugar pearls and fresh cold milk or tea.

subSections.name: Taro & Specialty
subSections.description: Nutty and comforting milk tea specialties incorporating natural mashed purple taro root, creamy coconut milk, and fragrant honeydew melon infusions.

sections.name: Fruit Tea
sections.description: Crisp, aromatic green, four-season oolong, and black teas vigorously hand-shaken with freshly squeezed citrus, crushed whole fruits, passion fruit pulp, and fruit purees. This required section delivers vibrant color appeal and refreshing hydration for dairy-free and health-conscious guests, supported by tailored sweetness, cooling ice calibration, and tropical jelly or popping boba add-ons.

subSections.name: Fresh Fruit Tea
subSections.description: Whole-leaf green and black teas muddled with real seasonal fruit slices, whole berries, and fragrant passion fruit seeds.

subSections.name: Citrus Series
subSections.description: Tart and revitalizing tea infusions highlighted by fresh lemon, calamansi, sweet kumquat, and ruby grapefruit.

subSections.name: Tropical Series
subSections.description: Sun-drenched exotic tea blends starring ripe mango puree, Hawaiian pineapple, aromatic lychee, and pink guava.

sections.name: Cheese Tea / Cream Top
sections.description: Artisanal cold-brewed loose-leaf teas and fresh fruit infusions crowned with an opulent layer of aerated cream cheese foam whipped with real milk and pink Himalayan sea salt. Designed to be sipped directly from a mustache-friendly sip lid at a 45-degree tilt to experience the contrast of savory creamy froth and fragrant tea liquor.

subSections.name: Cheese Green Tea
subSections.description: Floral jasmine green tea, roasted matcha, and jade green tea liquor topped with velvety salted cheese foam.

subSections.name: Cheese Oolong
subSections.description: Roasted Tieguanyin, white peach oolong, and high-mountain Taiwanese oolong teas layered with savory cheese froth.

subSections.name: Cheese Fruit Tea
subSections.description: Iced fruit purees and crushed strawberry, mango, or fresh grape tea blends capped with luxurious cheese foam.

choices.label: Extra Thick Cheese Foam (+50% Foam Layer)

sections.name: Specialty & Signature
sections.description: Showcase creations and multi-tiered layered drinks that represent the shop's artisanal pinnacle and social media viral favorites. Combines handcrafted gradient aesthetics, scorched crème brûlée finishes, floral botanicals, and premium culinary ingredients into memorable showstopper beverages.

subSections.name: House Signatures
subSections.description: The brand's definitive crowd-favorites, multi-layered visual gradient drinks, and proprietary customer go-tos.

subSections.name: Seasonal Creations
subSections.description: Creative barista recipes combining fresh seasonal produce, specialty flower infusions, and modern mixology.

subSections.name: Limited Editions
subSections.description: Exclusive small-batch drink series showcasing rare tea flushes, scorched crème brûlée custards, and artisan imports.

sections.name: Coffee
sections.description: Specialty Asian cafe coffee beverages and classic espresso extractions tailored for boba shop culture. Bridges the worlds of coffee and tea with Hong Kong-style coffee milk tea (Yuenyeung), Vietnamese slow-dripped iced coffees with condensed milk, and sea salt cream iced Americanos.

subSections.name: Coffee Milk Tea
subSections.description: Hong Kong Yuenyeung harmonizing bold Ceylon black tea, fresh espresso shots, and evaporated milk or sweet creamer.

subSections.name: Iced Coffee
subSections.description: Robust iced coffees including Vietnamese dark roast with sweetened condensed milk and sea salt cream cold brews.

subSections.name: Espresso Series
subSections.description: Classic espresso drinks including Americanos, caffe lattes, brown sugar boba lattes, and caramel macchiatos.

sections.name: Slush & Smoothie
sections.description: Ice-blended tropical fruit slushes, creamy probiotic yogurt smoothies, and rich ceremonial matcha frappes blended to fine icy perfection. Essential high-margin frosty treats during summer heat waves, designed with wide straws to pair seamlessly with chewable boba, fruit jellies, and decadent whipped cheese crowns.

subSections.name: Fruit Slush
subSections.description: Vibrant ice-blended slushes crafted with real fruit purees including mango, strawberry, lychee, passion fruit, and watermelon.

subSections.name: Yogurt Smoothie
subSections.description: Thick, creamy smoothies blending tangy Greek yogurt with ripe fruits and crushed ice for a balanced sweet-tart profile.

subSections.name: Matcha Blends
subSections.description: Premium Japanese Uji matcha blended into frosty frappes with sweet red bean swirls, creamy milk, or vanilla cream.

sections.name: Toppings Menu
sections.description: Master catalog of handcrafted chewy pearls, translucent jellies, rich silky custards, and traditional Asian sweet toppings. This section provides an inventory of all standalone modifiers, double-portion scoops, and separate takeaway side cups for enthusiasts seeking the ultimate 'QQ' chewy mouthfeel.

subSections.name: Pearls & Boba
subSections.description: Traditional brown sugar simmered tapioca pearls, translucent agar crystal boba, and burst-in-your-mouth fruit popping boba.

subSections.name: Jellies
subSections.description: Chewy nata de coco coconut jellies, soothing aloe vera cubes, traditional herbal grass jelly, and citrusy Taiwanese aiyu jelly.

subSections.name: Pudding & Cream
subSections.description: Silky vanilla egg pudding custards, whipped Himalayan sea salt cheese foam, and light dairy whipped cream.

subSections.name: Others
subSections.description: Traditional Asian dessert accompaniments including sweet azuki red beans, mini chewy taro balls, artisanal mochi, and crushed cookie crumbs.

choices.label: Chewy Mini Taro & Sweet Potato Balls

sections.name: Light Bites
sections.description: Taiwanese night market street foods, thick-sliced honey brick toasts, fresh egg waffles (gai daan jai), and sweet Asian pastries designed to complement tea drinking. Provides warm savory and sweet contrasts that boost food sales, group dining appeal, and average order value.

subSections.name: Taiwanese Snacks
subSections.description: Iconic Taiwanese street bites including crispy five-spice popcorn chicken, golden sweet potato fries with plum powder, and fried tofu cubes.

subSections.name: Toast & Bites
subSections.description: Thick Japanese milk bread honey brick toasts, condensed milk butter toast, garlic toast, and freshly pressed bubble egg waffles.

subSections.name: Desserts
subSections.description: Warm Japanese wheel cakes (imagawayaki) filled with custard or red bean, chewy mochi donuts, and matcha soft serve treats.

choices.label: Freshly Heated / Warm Out of Oven

timeBehavior.note: Light bites and freshly prepared street foods are made to order throughout regular operating hours.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited
sections.description: Rotating seasonal beverage launches, holiday specials, and limited-harvest tea collaborations. Creates recurring excitement, social media momentum, and immediate purchase urgency with flavors tied to cherry blossoms in spring, tropical mangoes in summer, spiced brown sugar in autumn, and roasted warm chestnuts in winter.

subSections.name: Spring & Summer Editions
subSections.description: Floral sakura blossom teas, fresh white peach oolong teas, watermelon frosty slushes, and mango pomelo sago specials.

subSections.name: Autumn & Winter Warmers
subSections.description: Warming spiced ginger brown sugar teas, roasted chestnut milk teas, and hot purple sweet potato lattes.

subSections.name: Festival & Collaboration Specials
subSections.description: Holiday celebrations, pop-culture collaboration drinks, dual-flavor split cups, and anniversary novelty recipes.

systemFeatures.name: Sweetness Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Essential bubble tea ordering feature enabling guests to precisely dictate syrup and sweetness percentages (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%, 120%) across milk teas, fruit teas, and specialty beverages.

systemFeatures.name: Ice Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Fundamental temperature and ice calibration feature allowing patrons to select ice volume (No Ice, Less Ice, Regular Ice, Extra Ice) or hot preparation where supported.

systemFeatures.name: Interactive Topping & Boba Builder
systemFeatures.description: Multi-select topping customization interface with individual price modifiers, allowing guests to layer multiple pearls, jellies, custards, and cheese foams in a single drink.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Flags allergens (dairy, soy, gluten, nuts, egg) and dietary lifestyles (vegan, lactose-free, caffeine-free, vegetarian) across all drink and food items.

systemFeatures.name: Live Stock & Fresh Batch Badges
systemFeatures.description: Displays real-time inventory alerts including Sold Out Today, Low Stock, Seasonal, and Fresh Boba Batch Cooked badges to manage guest expectations.
